-- =====================================================================================================
-- Dawak (دواك) — full database script in ONE file: extensions, enums, all 17 tables, indexes, triggers,
-- row-level security, grants, RPC functions (pharmacy list, availability requests "ask nearby", orders,
-- POS, public search, dashboard) and the private licence-documents storage bucket.
--
-- Generated by concatenating the nine files of supabase/migrations/ in order (do not edit by hand; edit
-- the migrations and regenerate with `python3 tool/build_full_sql.py`).
--
-- HOW TO USE (new, EMPTY Supabase project): Dashboard -> SQL Editor -> New query -> paste this whole file -> Run.
-- Do NOT run it twice on the same database: the objects are created without IF NOT EXISTS on purpose.
--
-- AFTER RUNNING (see docs/release_checklist.md section 1):
--   * Enable the pg_cron extension and schedule the three maintenance jobs (they are NOT created here):
--       private.expire_all_reservations()               every 5 minutes
--       private.advance_all_availability_requests()     every minute
--       delete from public.idempotency_keys ...         daily
--   * Optional: supabase/seed.sql (sample categories + medicines) and supabase/dev/bootstrap_first_admin.sql.
--
-- Verified only on a local PostgreSQL 16 with a stub of Supabase's auth/storage objects (see docs/progress.md);
-- never run on a real Supabase project.
-- =====================================================================================================
